mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 70 degrees at the Verona Community Park. Please be aware that we are under an air quality alert with an index of 63.

The city is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for local students to help shape our November election experience. Voting for the winning designs is currently open to the public through August 7, and you can participate either online or by using paper forms at City Hall.

There is plenty to do, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market happening today at Hometown Junction Park. Later this week, look forward to Concerts in the Park tomorrow at Century School Park and Hop Haus Trivia tomorrow evening.

Regarding local activity, on Monday, July 27, a Verona Police Department drone officer assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office in locating an individual who had fled from a residence in the Town of Springdale.

Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The shop opens at 10 AM, so head over to get your scoop. You can also catch Kona Ice today at Fireman's Park from 11 AM to 4:30 PM or at the Verona Farmers Market from 3 PM to 6:30 PM.
